The '''Tarasin Palace''' is located in the center of [[Ebou Dar]], the nominal capital of [[Altara]].{{ref|In reality, the ruler who sits on the [[Throne of the Winds]] does not control much land beyond the city's boundaries.}} It faces the [[Mol Hara]] square and is the governing building of the Altaran monarchy.

The ruler of the throne in {{Ne|998}} was Queen [[Tylin Quintara Mitsobar|Tylin Quintara]] of [[House Mitsobar]], who was murdered by a ''[[gholam]]''. She was succeeded by her son [[Beslan]], who accepted [[Seanchan]] authority as the foreign armies conquered Ebou Dar.
